text: Red flag er Marticans match, hvor han arka ut sine inska hangar i serhet, sjat moti klinellen. Ara, cine je for Martican, kosalu jamanak, kes ham sjat moti ken gaunam, ham skusven kes kapnel, vuzno sit heten harum, kocha kit heten harum, sens mazareten skusum uhet. Don't touch me! In harajot red flag da miszohi deru Martiken, irang unen jeresung harasuntarva kanki patbunsum, votah bolore meha, volen bolore wat Martiken. Iv vidang jepek, vorve skalban, chenare. Nu prosto surp. Ajort red flagem, ee, da einmartik en of ker ee, varumen, šat vat anglenas, et reckless. En 8 elusens šat surjert, euk tang ano, ner, v'tangi tag endu nu vožmen iren zayle vožmiri kanka. Njetu du kaid pesek, varum jes vožmen zerkoh ka čem nosti, ailev ceset čem šupfim. Jes, red flagem hamar may markant of ker feedback čeng au kanun lisen. Aish, ki noi nagwoy dan zases, vaik ang skars, mikis harun nestes, neymen bor shad moti kes nas, dan kauruk kes neymanan heta tas tarich, khosan bor shmi feedback, jinan kes kauran tas. Ee, una yev, ee, red flag inen martik, of ker cheng kauranum tunen voidang skalen, yev, yev pek neiro tun cheng khan turminat, egon prosto ka palviye tiran kang kinchur mi situasyon, an tunen vorinang skalen. Hazar ka ruk kapotaten teman, kes mega bor kahane, yev kanakin mega bor kahane, baithiran yev pek mega bor cheng. Res red flag cheng gatel, aits ka nasna kaltsin. Yut, hai, samana dzirmes, cika men karo, en klinnal, besties.
